SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT LEGACY_IV_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO FROM KEPGRHD WHERE 1=1 AND IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY LEGACY_IV_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KBPO' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(PLANT,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, NVL(LEGACY_PO_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(LEGACY_PO_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(GR_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, NVL(GR_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE, NVL(LEGACY_IV_NO ,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, NVL(LEGACY_IV_SEQ ,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(RO_QTY,0) AS RO_QTY, NVL(RO_AMT,0) AS RO_AMT, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM KEPGRHD WHERE 1=1 AND LEGACY_IV_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY LEGACY_IV_NO,LEGACY_IV_SEQ,LEGACY_PO_NO,LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE KEPGRHD SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND LEGACY_IV_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
